data.description: November 2025 records include iterative historical park-data requests and the same Thai NSO dashboard appearing on two scanning services within about 24 minutes. The NSO requests failed; timing alone does not identify a common requester. By March 2026, an ONCB custom fetch records a response relay, and a Roi Et labor-statistics table appears in both scanner-hosted content and a paste. These support deliberate research and answer publication more strongly than ordinary reputation checks. Human scripting and user-directed AI remain alternatives to autonomous RL agents. No authenticated chain connects the November cases to later wiki identities, and a shared logged-out scanner ID is not actor identity.
data.summary: Archived URLQuery records show task-directed retrieval as early as November 2025 and custom extraction/answer publication by March 2026. These extend the candidate activity timeline; AI authorship, RL context and a bridge to later wiki agents remain unproven.
